title: SlideTransition cannot resolve its horizontal offset from text direction
evidence: Flutter negates the horizontal offset when textDirection is rtl. Incular maps the Offset directly to FractionalTranslation at explicit_animations.rs:390 with no direction parameter. The LTR twin matches because both apply the same translation.
impact: In RTL layouts a ported reading-direction slide moves the wrong way.
cause: The sampled Offset is used without resolving direction.
fix_direction: Add an optional text direction and mirror the horizontal component for RTL.
limitations: No RTL frame twin; the Incular API cannot express the input.

title: SlideTransition cannot disable hit-test transforms
evidence: Flutter passes transformHitTests to FractionalTranslation. Incular constructs FractionalTranslation with the default true (transforms.rs:52) and has no transition setter (transforms.rs:58 exists only on the widget).
impact: Callers cannot keep hit regions at the child's final position during a slide.
cause: The convenience constructor always uses the default hit-test policy.
fix_direction: Expose the hit-test policy on SlideTransition::from_animation and pass it through.
limitations: Hit testing is not recorded by the frame harness; source only.

title: Matrix, scale and rotation transitions omit filterQuality
evidence: Geometry matches with no filtering. The Transform descriptor struct (descriptors.rs:1374-1385) has no filter-quality or sampling field; FilterQuality exists only on Image (descriptors.rs:110).
impact: Transformed raster content cannot request Flutter's sampling quality during scale, rotation or matrix transitions.
cause: The renderer-neutral Transform descriptor carries no image-filter option.
fix_direction: Add optional filter quality to the transition and Transform descriptor; apply it only while the animation runs.
limitations: Paint quality is not observable by the frame recorder; no pixel scene.

title: RelativePositionedTransition cannot represent a nullable rectangle
evidence: Non-null rectangles match. Flutter accepts Animation<Rect?> and maps null to Rect.zero; Incular requires TweenAnimation<Rect> (new at line 302).
impact: A positioned child cannot be animated through Flutter's null-to-zero rectangle behavior.
cause: The property tween requires concrete Rect endpoints.
fix_direction: Accept an optional rect animation and map None to Rect::ZERO at layout.

title: DecoratedBoxTransition only accepts BoxDecoration
evidence: BoxDecoration color interpolation matches. The constructor (line 341) takes TweenAnimation<BoxDecoration>; Flutter takes Animation<Decoration>.
impact: Other Decoration implementations, such as ShapeDecoration, cannot be animated through this transition.
cause: The retained transition is specialized to BoxDecoration.
fix_direction: Accept a renderer-neutral decoration interpolation covering Flutter's supported types, or name the API box-only.

title: SliverFadeTransition requires an OpacityController
evidence: transitions__sliver_fade__opacity matches when the controller is set directly. The constructor (sliver_fade.rs:23) accepts only OpacityController; Flutter accepts Animation<double>.
impact: A curved, reversed or composed animation cannot drive a sliver fade directly.
cause: The sliver wrapper is coupled to the retained opacity controller.
fix_direction: Add a constructor accepting DoubleAnimation, keeping the controller constructor.

title: AnimatedWidget has no direct public base equivalent
evidence: Flutter provides a subclassable listening base. Incular has the internal animated_widget_for helper (explicit_animations.rs:95) and closure-based AnimatedBuilder/ListenableBuilder. The builder scenario matches; subclass lifecycle is not represented.
impact: Ported custom animated widgets must be restructured around a closure builder.
cause: Incular exposes closure builders and composition rather than a subclassable state base.
fix_direction: Consider a public builder or retained-state trait with explicit listenable lifecycle if subclass parity is a goal.

title: SizeTransition clamps negative fixed cross-axis factors instead of asserting
evidence: The valid-factor twin matches. Flutter asserts a non-negative fixedCrossAxisSizeFactor; animation_transitions.rs:227 silently applies factor.max(0.0).
impact: A bad configuration surfaces in Flutter debug builds but yields a zero cross-axis size silently in Incular.
cause: Invalid input is normalized instead of rejected.
fix_direction: Align the validity check and failure behavior, or document the normalization.

title: RelativeRectTween has no named public counterpart
evidence: rg -n RelativeRectTween over crates/ finds nothing. The positioned twin interpolates the same values through the generic TweenAnimation.
impact: Code that names or composes Flutter's RelativeRectTween must substitute the generic tween.
cause: Incular centralizes typed interpolation in generic tween wrappers.
fix_direction: Expose a named RelativeRectTween if source compatibility is a goal, or document the generic replacement.

title: StatusTransitionWidget has no Incular equivalent
evidence: Flutter's base widget rebuilds on every AnimationStatus change through a status listener. rg finds no public status-only rebuild base. DualTransitionBuilder computes an effective status internally. Flutter 3.41 has no framework subclass of StatusTransitionWidget in lib/src/widgets.
impact: Callers cannot write a status-driven rebuild widget that does not depend on the value; they must use value-driven builders or DualTransitionBuilder.
cause: Incular exposes value-driven builders and a dual-transition helper, not a status-listening base.
fix_direction: Low priority: add a status-listening builder only if source compatibility with StatusTransitionWidget is a goal.
limitations: Source reading only; no frame twin.
